simple.meaning: a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דֹּבֶר (H1699) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: דֹּבֶר (dôber) means a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock) First listed occurrence: Isa 5 17.

definitions.short: a pasture (from its arrangement of the flock)
definitions.full: H1699. dober [ דֹּ֫בֶר ] noun [masculine] pasture (compare Aramaic דַּבְרָא , Syriac ) — suffix הַדָּֽבְרוֺ בְּתוֺךְ כְּעֵדֶר as a flock in the midst of its pasture Micah 2:12 (article with suffix, compare Ges § 127 , 4 b, who attaches ו as conjunction to following word); כְּדֳבְרָם כְבָשִׂים וְרָעזּ and lambs shall feed as (in) their pasture Isa 5:17 . דִּבֵּר noun [masculine] speaking (so Ew § 156 ) Jer 5:13 בָּהֶם אֵין וְהַדִּבֵּר ; according to Hi Gf Ki (less probably) verb with article for relation (see [ דָּבַר ] Pi`el ): but read rather הַדָּבָר , and the word is not in them .
